title: Active Learning with Imperfect Labels: Optimal Labeler Assignment and Sample Selection
abstract: arXiv:2512.12870v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Active Learning (AL) is commonly used in applications where labeling data is expensive or time-consuming. In practice, however, labels are often noisy due to varying labeler expertise and annotation uncertainty, especially for complex or ambiguous samples. Learning from such imperfectly labeled data can degrade classifier performance. We propose an AL framework that explicitly accounts for label noise by optimally assigning labelers and selecting samples to minimize labeling error. Our approach, called OLAS (Optimal Labeler Assignment and Sampling), uses a noise model that depends on both labeler accuracy and model uncertainty to guide these decisions. We develop two tractable optimization formulations: one for assigning samples to labelers to minimize worst-case noise, and another for selecting samples while controlling overall label noise. Theoretical results provide closed-form solutions under mild conditions. Empirical eval

translated_title: 带有不完美标签的主动学习：最优标注者分配与样本选择
translated_abstract: 主动学习常用于标注数据昂贵或耗时的应用场景。然而在实践中，由于标注者专业水平的差异以及标注的不确定性，标签往往存在噪声，尤其是对于复杂或模糊的样本。从这类标注不完美的数据中学习会降低分类器的性能。我们提出了一种主动学习框架，通过最优地分配标注者和选择样本来最小化标注误差，从而显式地考虑标签噪声。我们的方法称为 OLAS（Optimal Labeler Assignment and Sampling，最优标注者分配与采样），它使用一个同时取决于标注者准确率和模型不确定性的噪声模型来指导这些决策。我们开发了两种可求解的优化形式：一种用于将样本分配给标注者以最小化最坏情况下的噪声，另一种用于在选择样本的同时控制整体标签噪声。理论结果在温和的条件下给出了闭式解。实验评估表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了名为OLAS的主动学习框架，基于标注者准确率和模型不确定性的噪声模型，通过联合优化标注者分配与样本选择来最小化标签噪声，并在温和条件下提供闭式理论解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OLAS, an active learning framework that optimally assigns labelers and selects samples based on a noise model combining labeler accuracy and model uncertainty, providing tractable optimization formulations with closed-form solutions to minimize label noise.
